title: Propensity Score Weighting (IPTW)
prompt: Explain **Propensity Score Weighting (IPTW)**: $w_i = \frac{T_i}{e(X_i)} + \frac{1 - T_i}{1 - e(X_i)}$. What happens to the variance of your causal estimate when some propensity scores $e(X_i)$ are very close to $0$ or $1$ (Violation of Positivity / Overlap assumption), and how does weight trimming or Doubly Robust estimation fix it?
